subject: C05
performed_by: Claude Code driving the real fixture window through macOS Accessibility (tools/native-acceptance/ax.swift, ax_colors.swift, System Events keystrokes) against the synthetic Academy endpoint tools/native-acceptance/academy_server.py serving tools/native-acceptance/academy_catalog.py; tools/native-acceptance/acceptance_c05.py

checks.description: Signed out, the Academy destination shows Academy's own catalog ('What will you take up next?') with a note that the learner is browsing as a guest; the endpoint receives only public catalog procedures, none with an Authorization header, and no identity-provider requests.
checks.observation: guest catalog with the guest note: True; learner calls ['paths.list', 'library.list'] all public and without Authorization: True; identity or other requests: 0

checks.description: After signing in, the Academy catalog is read again under the account without the guest note; requests carry the account credential exactly for procedures on the desktop account allowlist.
checks.observation: signed in: True; catalog re-read under the account without the guest note: True; calls (procedure, Authorization): [['paths.list', True], ['library.list', True]]

checks.description: From the catalog's Courses filter, the course page and its module units open; a lesson exposes its heading and first paragraph and all section headings of a 50 KiB lesson; the trail 'Learn › <course>' links back to the course.
checks.observation: lesson heading: True; first paragraph exposed: True; 22 section headings in a 51968 byte lesson; trail links ['Learn', 'Runtime Security Foundations']; trail back to the course: True

checks.description: A lesson diagram shows its pre-rendered image ('Lesson diagram') with its source under a disclosure, a diagram without an artifact shows its source, and no diagram video is requested; an external lesson link opens nothing, keeps the window on the lesson and states it was not opened; an in-page anchor stays on the lesson; a learner-path link routes to the catalog in place.
checks.observation: pre-rendered diagram image 'Lesson diagram': {'role': 'AXGroup', 'size': [328, 64]}; source disclosure: True; artifact-less diagram shows its source: True; diagram video requests: 0; external link notice: True, window still on the lesson: True, pages handed to the browser: []; in-page anchor stays on the lesson: True; learner-path link routes to the catalog: True

checks.description: Signed in, a knowledge check starts, takes an answer and submits through the endpoint with the literal fixture request bodies and the account credential; the server's grade ('You scored 100%', '1 of 1 correct') is shown; no answer key appears in any AX snapshot.
checks.observation: 'You scored 100%': True; '1 of 1 correct': True; start body is the literal fixture: True; submit body is the literal fixture: True; both with Authorization: True; answer keys or canaries in AX snapshots: []

checks.description: As a guest, starting a knowledge check says 'Sign in to take this knowledge check.' and sends nothing to Academy.
checks.observation: guest 'Start knowledge check' shows 'Sign in to take this knowledge check.': True; learner calls sent for it: []

checks.description: A hands-on lab unit is previewed with its title and brief and says no lab sandbox was started; no lab start, step or submit request is made.

checks.observation: learner markers in Runtime Security: []; in Harness: []; learner calls while away from Academy: []

checks.description: Content access as Academy decides it: a guest at members-only or progression-locked content sees Academy's sign-in gate (endpoint 401, no credential); signed in, locked content shows 'This content is locked' with its progression reason (endpoint 403 FORBIDDEN with the domain code), members-only content opens, and retired content says 'Unit not found.' without any gate.
checks.observation: guest at members-only and locked content: sign-in gate True/True, endpoint replies (status, Authorization) [[401, False]]/[[401, False]]; signed in, locked content shows 'This content is locked' with the progression reason: True (no sign-in gate: True), replies [[403, True]]; members-only content opens: True [[200, True]]; retired content 'Unit not found.' without a gate: True [[404, True]]

checks.description: Failures stay visible and truthful: a guest pressing 'Complete & continue' is asked to sign in, stays on the lesson and sends nothing; a knowledge-check submission the server fails after receiving it says Academy may have recorded it, keeps the answer, hides the server text and is sent once.
checks.observation: guest 'Complete & continue' asks to sign in and stays on the lesson: True; learner calls sent: ['paths.list']; a submission the server failed after receiving shows 'Academy may have recorded this submission': True, answer kept: True, server text hidden: True; submissions sent (status, Authorization): [[500, True]]

limitations: Academy is a local synthetic endpoint answering Academy's learner procedures with synthetic catalog content shaped after Academy's routers at the pinned commit; hosted Academy is qualified in C25 (L11).
Browser approval is simulated by the synthetic token endpoint; the fixture build records pages instead of launching a browser.
Spoken VoiceOver output was not recorded; AX roles, names, focus and live status regions are inspected. Screen capture is not available to this session, so themes are checked through AX text colors.
